artifact.statement: Enable real-time error preview during spreadsheet imports to allow users to identify and correct invalid rows before finalizing the import.
artifact.mechanism: Implement a feature that highlights invalid rows in the spreadsheet with specific error messages, allowing users to edit or remove them before submission.
artifact.title: Preview Import Errors for Spreadsheet Corrections
artifact.summary: Users can now preview and correct errors in their spreadsheets during the import process, reducing manual retyping efforts.
